== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Heaven’s Glory School]] is a prominent organization located on [[Mount Samara]], the tallest of the four [[holy peaks]] in [[Sacred Valley]]. The school's location is characterized by a permanent [[ring]] of pale light circling the summit, an ancient [[aura]] construction that provides constant illumination and allows disciples to gather light-aspect energy even during the night. The school's architecture is notable for its impressive, glistening buildings sculpted from riverstone, which appear as though they are perpetually wet or drenched in milk under the mountain's halo. Members of the school are identified by specific attire, typically consisting of white and gold clothing with red sashes, and they wear badges that denote their rank or station. The organization features various roles, including apprentices, guards, and elders such as Whitehall{{!}}Elder Whitehall and [[Elder Rahm]]. The school also utilizes specialized [[constructs]] and artifacts, often characterized by golden light, blue energy, or Goldsteel{{!}}goldsteel materials. One of their significant facilities is the [[Lesser Treasure Hall]], a large repository for various treasures and artifacts. The school possesses unique techniques, such as Heaven’s Wish, which allows a practitioner to transfer nearly all of their power and skill to an heir. While the school is known for its majesty and impressive resources, it has also been associated with ruthless military advances and tactical combat involving enforcers and specialized striker techniques.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Initially considered by [[Lindon]] as a group worthy of a chance, Heaven's Glory is a settlement composed of warriors and defenders featuring buildings made of pale [[orus wood]] and [[rainstone]]. The group was observed attacking an exile camp with fire and slicing techniques before being driven away by a celestial fire. Following the establishment of leadership by [[Eithan]], the location became a destination for the [[Akura Golds]] and a refuge for those fleeing toward its passageway. During a period of mass movement, hundreds of thousands of people utilized the site as humanity pushed to leave through its gates. Ultimately, the group rebuilt the [[Ancestor's Tomb]], and the location remains a place where [[Elder Whisper]] can visit unseen.}}
